name: codex-manager
description: Manage multiple Codex accounts in VS Code, inspect quota, and switch the active global auth.json.

codexManager.codexAppRestartMode.markdownDescription: How to handle the Codex desktop experience restart when switching accounts. Supports both the merged ChatGPT app and legacy Codex app. `auto` restarts it automatically, `manual` asks you to click restart each time.

codexManager.codexAppRestartEnabled.markdownDescription: Whether Codex Manager should manage the ChatGPT/Codex desktop app when switching accounts. Turn this off to skip restart prompts and app handling entirely.

codexManager.dashboardTheme.markdownDescription: Theme used by the Codex Manager dashboard. `auto` follows the current VS Code color theme.

codexManager.displayLanguage.markdownDescription: Language used by Codex Manager. Version 1.0.0 uses English throughout the extension.

codexManager.autoRefreshMinutes.markdownDescription: Automatically refresh all saved account quotas every N minutes. Set to `0` to disable, or choose any interval from `1` to `60` minutes.

codexManager.autoRefreshCurrentMinutes.markdownDescription: Automatically refresh only the current active account quota every N minutes. Set to `0` to disable, or choose any interval from `1` to `60` minutes.

codexManager.usageHistoryRetentionDays.markdownDescription: How long quota graph history is retained. Choose a retention period from `1` to `90` days.

codexManager.cliIntegrationEnabled.markdownDescription: Experimental Workspace: enable the dashboard workspace, local Codex CLI sessions, and terminal tools. Disabled by default; no session files are read while this is off.

codexManager.backgroundTokenRefreshEnabl.markdownDescription: Allow the extension to refresh saved account tokens in the background. Disabled by default; Codex manages its own token refresh unless you enable this.

codexManager.autoSwitchEnabled.markdownDescription: Automatically switch away from the active account when its quota falls below the configured hourly or weekly threshold. Candidates are ranked by highest remaining 5-hour quota, then highest weekly quota.

codexManager.hourlyQuotaControlEnabled.markdownDescription: Show the 5-hour quota in the status bar and allow it to trigger automatic account switching and quota warning notifications. The quota remains visible in the dashboard.

codexManager.autoSwitchReloadWindowEnabl.markdownDescription: Automatically reload the current VS Code window after an automatic account switch when the active runtime account changes.

codexManager.autoSwitchHourlyThreshold.markdownDescription: Automatic account switching threshold for the 5-hour quota. Switching is triggered when the active account drops to or below this percentage.

codexManager.autoSwitchWeeklyThreshold.markdownDescription: Automatic account switching threshold for the weekly quota. Switching is triggered when the active account drops to or below this percentage.

codexManager.autoSwitchRefreshAllBeforeS.markdownDescription: When the warning threshold is reached, refresh enabled account quotas before showing the notification so the recommended switch account is current. If every account is below the automatic-switch threshold, the configured all-account timer resumes and includes the current account until one becomes capable.

codexManager.autoResetEnabled.markdownDescription: When all enabled accounts are out of quota, automatically consume an available reset credit on an eligible account, refresh it, and switch to it.

codexManager.autoResetWeeklyThreshold.markdownDescription: Weekly quota percentage at or below which the reset plan may consume a reset credit.

codexManager.autoSwitchLockMinutes.markdownDescription: Default lock duration in minutes when temporarily locking the current account against automatic account switching. Set to `0` to disable locking by default.

codexManager.codexAppPath.markdownDescription: Optional custom path to the Codex desktop app. If empty, the extension uses built-in platform-specific detection.

codexManager.codexCliPath.markdownDescription: Optional custom path to the Codex CLI executable or launcher script. If empty, the extension uses CODEX_CLI_PATH, the bundled CLI, or the codex command on PATH.

codexManager.quotaWarningEnabled.markdownDescription: Show a warning notification when the active account's 5-hour or weekly remaining quota drops below the configured threshold.

codexManager.quotaWarningThreshold.markdownDescription: Warning threshold percentage for the active account's 5-hour remaining quota.

codexManager.quotaWarningWeeklyThreshold.markdownDescription: Warning threshold percentage for the active account's weekly remaining quota.

codexManager.quotaGreenThreshold.markdownDescription: Quota percentage at or above this value is shown in green.

codexManager.quotaYellowThreshold.markdownDescription: Quota percentage at or above this value is shown in yellow. Values below this threshold are shown in red.

codexManager.debugNetwork.markdownDescription: Enable sanitized network debug logs for Codex Manager requests in the `Codex Manager Network` output channel.

codexManager.encryptedSyncEnabled.markdownDescription: Synchronize saved account sessions and the per-account PC enablement registry through VS Code Settings Sync using a client-side encrypted vault. Major vault changes—including add/import, removal, reauthorization, enable/disable, and token-refresh settings—are queued and coalesced. Signed WebSocket/HTTP peer updates remain realtime without consuming Settings Sync requests; account usage, switching, quota refreshes, and schedules never create sync traffic.

codexManager.webDashboardEnabled.markdownDescription: Run the local browser dashboard on 127.0.0.1:39875. Local access does not require a password. Set a password before exposing the port through Cloudflared or another tunnel.

codexManager.webDashboardAlwaysOnlineEna.markdownDescription: Keep a detached Node.js WebSocket relay running after VS Code closes. Enable this on one always-on PC; it takes over port 39875 after VS Code exits. The normal VS Code dashboard remains available while VS Code is running.

codexManager.cloudflaredDomain.markdownDescription: Optional HTTPS Cloudflared domain for the dashboard, for example https://codex.example.com. Point the tunnel to http://127.0.0.1:39875 and set a Web Dashboard password before sharing it. Leave empty to use local access only.
